'''Pollus Avesta''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Makeb]], and the younger brother of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] head of state, [[Shalim Avesta]].

==Biography==
During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], Pollus Avesta commanded the [[Avesta family|family's]] troops in the field against the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and the [[InterStellar Regulators]]. In order to arrange a distraction so that they could harvest the planet's supply of [[isotope-5]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] worked with Avesta to arrange a planet-wide revolt against the Hutts. Though skeptical of the Empire's motives, Avesta agreed to organize a coordinated strike against Cartel and Regulator forces.<ref name="Aflame">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|A World Aflame|Makeb}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Female Imperial players have the option to flirt with him.<ref name="Aflame" />
